RISK_META.method: Risk Management Process v1.0 — 5×5, risk level = likelihood × consequence
RISK_META.reviewCadence: Top management reviews the register every six months; each risk carries an annual evaluation date
RISK_META.acceptanceNote: The register template carries explicit "treatment accepted by" and "residual risk accepted by" columns so that risk-owner acceptance is demonstrable.

KEY_RISKS.title: Confidential data entered into unapproved AI tools
KEY_RISKS.treatment: AI usage policy published; human validation of AI outputs required; awareness training on data leakage.

KEY_RISKS.title: Shared administrator account used by external IT provider
KEY_RISKS.treatment: Replace the shared credential with individual named admin accounts and MFA.

KEY_RISKS.title: Staff unable to recognise realistic phishing attempts
Customer contract security obligations not tracked
KEY_RISKS.treatment: Define an owner and a contractual obligations register.

KEY_RISKS.title: Asset inventory incomplete at Harbour office
KEY_RISKS.treatment: Complete asset identification and classification at Harbour office.

KEY_RISKS.title: Prolonged cloud provider region outage disrupts the SaaS platform
KEY_RISKS.treatment: Multi-region failover design and a quarterly restore test.

KEY_RISKS.title: Certificate lapse during re-certification affects customer contracts
KEY_RISKS.treatment: Accepted. Sales keeps affected customers informed.

RISK_ACCEPTANCE.authority: Risk owner approves the plan at each review — name and date recorded
Named risk owner accepts, with residual level and date recorded in the register
Top management reviews the register every six months
Departmental registers escalate to the group register
Internal audit verifies that acceptances are recorded
